title: Microreserve-backed pricing corridor and temp talent matrix
content:
Purpose:
A compact, operational workbook that ties a small, fungible finance reserve ("microreserve") to a pricing corridor and a temporary-hire rotation matrix. Goal: automatic, low-friction responses to short-term pricing slippage or token-volume shocks without immediately touching full-time hiring or long-term commitments. Intended as the governing sheet for Q4 2026 pilot.

Quick summary (one-line):
Create a 3-layer protective buffer that (1) defers hiring decisions for 8–12 weeks, (2) smooths pricing/margin moves inside a defined corridor, and (3) uses a ranked pool of contingent contractors to absorb short spikes.

Key assumptions (editable cells):
- Monthly ARR baseline: $6,200,000
- Baseline token revenue (net of credits): $1,250,000 / month
- Gross margin target: 68%
- Microreserve target size: 2% of monthly ARR (floor $75k, cap $250k)
- Contingent average fully-loaded monthly cost (per FTE-equivalent): $18,000
- Time-to-ramp for contractor role (to useful throughput): 3 weeks (SWE), 4 weeks (ML infra), 2 weeks (Platform eng ops)

Microreserve rules (operational):
- Funding: top of month transfer from operating cash -> microreserve until target size reached.
- Usage: only for (A) absorb immediate margin shortfall triggered by price softness inside corridor, (B) temporary bridging for critical capacity when hiring would be too slow, (C) one-time investment in temporary infra credits to avoid SLA breaches.
- Replenishment: microreserve replenished to target within next 3 full months when depleted >50%.
- Governance: Finance Ops owner must sign off on any >$35k single draw and notify GTM/Product within 24h.

Pricing corridor definition (live knobs):
- Corridor center = current blended effective price per 1k tokens (EPP). Example: EPP = $0.045 / 1k tokens.
- Upper band = +12% above center. Lower band = -9% below center.
- If blended EPP moves inside corridor: allow margin smoothing using microreserve for up to 8 weeks.
- If EPP breaches lower band for 3 consecutive weeks: trigger Tier-1 actions (temporary hiring pool, temporary discounts rollback review, gating new freemium credits).

Sensitivity table (simple, meant to be a spreadsheet pivot view):
Columns: scenario, revenue delta, microreserve draw, projected runway shift (weeks), contingent hires activated, action notes
Rows (examples):
- Base: 0%, $0, 0, 0, no action
- Soft price (-10% EPP): -$125k/mo, draw $80k (cap), runway -1.9 weeks, 2 contractor SWE (stretch), pause non-critical hiring
- Demand surge (+30% tokens): +$375k/mo revenue, negative draw ($0 replenish), runway +3.0 weeks, no hires, pre-purchase GPU spot credits (if cost-optimal)
- Mixed (price -6% but tokens +15%): +$62.5k/mo, draw $0, runway +0.5w, monitor, no hires

Contingent hiring rotation matrix (ranked pool):
Columns: role, priority rank, monthly fully-loaded cost, expected useful ramp (weeks), trigger threshold, rotation cap (concurrent)
Rows:
- SWE (inference infra) | 1 | $18,000 | 3 | microreserve draw >$40k OR 10% SLA latency uplift | 3
- ML infra engineer | 2 | $20,500 | 4 | sustained queue growth >15% for 2 weeks | 2
- Platform ops (SRE) | 3 | $17,000 | 2 | error budget burn >50% in 1 week | 2
- Sales technical lead (temp) | 4 | $14,000 | 2 | churn risk >5% for top-tier accounts | 1

Activation rules (algorithmic checklist):
1) Weekly scorecard runs every Monday by Finance Ops + Product: compute blended EPP, token volume trend, SLA signal.
2) If price inside corridor and microreserve > floor -> allow up to 8-week smoothing; log draw in ledger.
3) If price crosses lower band for 3 wks or token volume drops >12% for 2 wks -> activate ranked contingent pool starting at rank 1 until microreserve is exhausted or trigger resolves.
4) If microreserve exhausted and negative trend persists -> escalate to hiring freeze + pricing negotiations with sales + exec review.

Numerical worked example (editable scenario in sheet):
- Baseline: ARR $6.2M, monthly cashflow margin $850k. EPP moves -10%.
- Expected revenue change: -$125k / month.
- Microreserve target = max(2%*ARR, floor) = max($124k, $75k) => $124k (cap not hit).
- Draw needed to maintain margin target for 8 weeks = $80k (example calc cell: shortfall * smoothing factor 0.5 * weeks).
- Contractor cost to bridge two SWE equivalents for 8 weeks = 2 * $18k * 2 months = $72k.
- Total draw = $80k + $72k = $152k -> exceeds microreserve target, so action becomes: draw microreserve $124k, hire 1 contractor only (1 SWE) and apply non-critical hiring pause.

Sheet tabs recommended (for implementation):
- assumptions (single source of truth for all knobs)
- scenario-runner (grid of several price/volume combos, auto-calculates draws and recommended actions)
- contingent-pool (active contractors, start/end dates, cost ledger)
- ledger (microreserve inflows/outflows + notes + approver)
- runbooks (one-line playbooks for each trigger)

Open questions / risks to surface:
- Does microreserve create moral hazard for GTM teams to push discounts? propose cap on ad-hoc promotional credits if microreserve used.
- Contract length: contingent contractors beyond 12 weeks start trending to FTE economics; require hiring committee review at 8 weeks.
- Tax/benefit implications for frequent contractor rotations across regions (need People Ops advise).

Next steps (owner: Priya Nair):
- Convert this doc into a sheet with the recommended tabs and sample formulas (target: 2 business days).
- Run two backtests using historical Q1–Q3 2026 data to validate corridor bands (owner: Ethan) by 2026-11-20.
- Draft a one-page playbook for GTM + Engineering on allowed behaviors when microreserve is used (owner: Maya) by 2026-11-22.

Action checklist for first 30d pilot:
- [ ] Create sheet and link to finance ledger (DONE?).
- [ ] Seed microreserve with initial transfer ($124k target).
- [ ] Populate contingent pool contacts and contracts (Aaron).
- [ ] Schedule weekly scorecard meetings (Finance + Product + SRE).

Notes + audit trail template (example row format for ledger):
Date, Draw (USD), Purpose, Approver, Notes, Linked ticket
2026-11-10, 124000, "Q4 price softness smoothing", Priya Nair, "Activated contractor X for 6 weeks", FIN-7890

Rationales (concise):
- Small, time-boxed financial buffers are cheaper and faster than repeated headcount cycles.
- A ranked contingent pool preserves delivery while minimizing long-term hiring mistakes.
- Corridor bands are intentionally asymmetric (smaller downside band) to force action earlier on adverse moves.

If you want I can:
- produce the actual sheet with formulas and named ranges, or
- run a sensitivity sweep over past quarters and output a recommended band set.

-- end of sheet draft --
